admission.justification: A launch whose send left no snapshot would be asserted against a later tree and pass; the send-time case fails on that fault and passes once the snapshot is required.

applicability: Every absolute path a first message emits, at the moment the host is handed that message.
conditions: A path containing a space is checked whole, not cut at the space.
The snapshot taken at send is the one asserted later, and a missing snapshot fails rather than reading as clean.
exclusions: The report paths and folders the role itself writes, and earlier report paths a successor line names.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_role_first_message.py, 245 subtests across five harnesses; a4-b07-before-after.txt (df6593a4…) records the fault accepted before the repair and caught after

statement: Every absolute path a first message emits is checked, whole and including one that contains a space, at the moment the host is handed that message, and the snapshot of that send is the one asserted later — absence of a snapshot is a failure, not a clean read.
